info.title: Alternative Macro & Economic Indices
info.description:
Institutional-grade alternative macroeconomic indices, leading business-cycle signals, and quantitative regime analytics engineered by stalter (https://stalter.work).

Tracks 15 non-traditional leading indicators across four dimensions/categories (with 0-100 cyclical scores, Z-Scores, multi-year history, Big Mac PPP currency valuations, and 2001/2008/2020/2022 historical crisis cosine similarity):
- consumer (Dimension 1 — Consumer Psychology): lipstick, underwear, rv-leisure, alcohol-scissors
- manufacturing (Dimension 2 — Physical Manufacturing & Capex): cardboard, heavy-truck, electricity-pulse, skyscraper
- commodities (Dimension 3 — Cross-Border PPP & Macro Commodities): bigmac, copper-gold, gold-oil, breakfast-inflation
- labor-credit (Dimension 4 — Labor Psychology, Credit & Comfort Demand): quits-confidence, vegas-credit, comfort-food

Targeted Category & Point-in-Time Filtering:
- Scope filters (`dimension`, `category`, `/v1/categories/{category}`): Fetch only the indices/dimensions you need instead of all 15.
- Time filters (`month`, `asOf`, `fromMonth`, `toMonth` in `YYYY-MM`):
  - `month=YYYY-MM`: Exact calendar month match; returns empty (`null` / `[]`) if an index has no publication for that month (strict non-fallback).
  - `asOf=YYYY-MM`: Point-in-time snapshot (`<= YYYY-MM`, latest available reading on or before that month); returns empty if none exist.
  - `fromMonth` / `toMonth`: Inclusive closed/half-open monthly range.

Endpoints & 3-Tier Access (Basic / Pro / Ultra):
- GET /v1/health (All tiers): Gateway readiness, L1 cache coverage, and active subscription tier
- GET /v1/catalog (All tiers): 15-index registry & categories metadata (filterable by `dimension` or `category`)
- GET /v1/categories/{category} (Pro & Ultra full category series up to 24 obs + time filters; Basic returns HTTP 200 previewMode)
- GET /v1/indices/{slug} (Basic: latest 1 obs / 5 rpm, HTTP 200 previewMode on historical queries; Pro: up to 36 mos / 30 rpm; Ultra: up to 120 mos / 120 rpm)
- GET /v1/regime-summary (Pro & Ultra full/filtered by `dimension`/`category` & `month`/`asOf`; Basic returns HTTP 200 previewMode summary)
- GET /v1/crisis-similarity (Ultra full 4-crisis matrix with `month`/`asOf` historical backtest; Basic/Pro return HTTP 200 previewMode label)
- GET /v1/batch (Ultra full/filtered via `slugs`, `dimension`/`category`, and `month`/`asOf`/`fromMonth`/`toMonth`; Basic/Pro return HTTP 200 previewMode slice)

Built on U.S. Government Public Domain series (FRED®, Federal Reserve Board H.10 FX, BLS/JOLTS, BEA, U.S. Census Bureau, EIA, DOT, SEC EDGAR XBRL) and CC BY 4.0 datasets (The Economist Big Mac Index, World Bank Pink Sheet Gold). Raw restricted third-party spot quotes (raw copper, gold, and cocoa spot quotes) are redacted.

Notice & Attribution:
- This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
- Contains data adapted from The Economist Big Mac Index dataset (CC BY 4.0) and World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet, CC BY 4.0).
- Derived indices incorporate IMF Primary Commodity Price System series retrieved via FRED; IMF does not endorse this product.
- Corporate revenue fundamentals are parsed from public U.S. SEC EDGAR XBRL filings.
- Authorized for personal quantitative research, algorithmic backtesting, and internal AI agent workflows under RapidAPI Basic/Pro/Ultra plans. Does not constitute investment advice, securities recommendations, or regulated advisory services.

get.summary: Gateway health and cache readiness check
get.description: Returns gateway status, active subscription tier (when proxied via RapidAPI), tracked index count, and L1 in-memory cache coverage. Available across Basic, Pro, and Ultra plans.

get.summary: List alternative macroeconomic indices, categories, and licensing metadata
get.description: Returns authoritative metadata, category classification, analytical dimension (1-4), licensing status, redacted raw fields, upstream sources, and required upstream attributions across all 15 alternative indices (or filtered by dimension/category). Available across Basic, Pro, and Ultra plans.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Optional filter by analytical dimension (1 = consumer, 2 = manufacturing, 3 = commodities, 4 = labor-credit, or comma-separated e.g. 1,2). Cannot be combined with category (HTTP 400).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional filter by semantic category slug (consumer, manufacturing, commodities, labor-credit, or comma-separated e.g. consumer,manufacturing). Cannot be combined with dimension (HTTP 400).

200.description: Catalog metadata with required compliance notices

429.description: Too Many Requests — Plan rate limit exceeded

get.summary: Retrieve time series for all indices in a specific category (Full: Pro/Ultra; Preview: Basic)
get.description: Fetches sanitized observations for all 3-4 indicators within one macroeconomic category (`consumer`, `manufacturing`, `commodities`, `labor-credit`, or numeric alias `1`..`4`). Pro (36-mo window) and Ultra (120-mo window) support up to 24 observations per index and exact/point-in-time/range time filters; Basic receives HTTP 200 previewMode (first 2 slugs, latest 1 obs).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Macroeconomic category slug (consumer, manufacturing, commodities, labor-credit; OpenAPI enum lists the 4 canonical slugs while the gateway also accepts numeric dimension aliases 1-4)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Observations per index (1-24, default 1)

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Exact month match in YYYY-MM format (returns [] for indices with no record in that month)

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Point-in-time snapshot on or before YYYY-MM (latest available reading <= asOf; returns [] if none)

parameters.name: fromMonth
parameters.description: Inclusive range lower bound in YYYY-MM format

parameters.name: toMonth
parameters.description: Inclusive range upper bound in YYYY-MM format

200.description: Sanitized category time-series matrix (or preview slice on Basic plan)

400.description: Invalid limit or time filter parameter

429.description: Too Many Requests — Plan rate limit exceeded

get.summary: Retrieve latest snapshot and historical quantitative series for a single index
get.description: Returns sanitized derived scores (0-100 indexValue, Z-Scores, signals, trends, YoY ratios, and PPP valuations) for one alternative economic index. History depth and time filters are enforced by subscription tier (Basic: latest 1 obs only, HTTP 200 previewMode on historical queries; Pro: up to 36 months; Ultra: up to 120 months).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Alternative economic index identifier

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of observations to return. Defaults to 1 on Basic and 14 on Pro/Ultra when omitted; values exceeding the active tier cap (Basic=1, Pro=36, Ultra=120) are clamped to the plan cap rather than rejected.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Exact month match in YYYY-MM format (Pro/Ultra; returns null/[] if missing for that month)

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Point-in-time snapshot <= YYYY-MM (Pro/Ultra; returns null/[] if no observation <= asOf)

parameters.name: fromMonth
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound filter in YYYY-MM format (Pro/Ultra)

parameters.name: toMonth
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound filter in YYYY-MM format (Pro/Ultra)

200.description: Sanitized index snapshot and historical series

400.description: Invalid limit or time filter parameter

429.description: Too Many Requests — Plan rate limit exceeded

get.summary: Macro regime radar across all 15 indices or a filtered category/month (Full: Pro/Ultra; Preview: Basic)
get.description: Aggregates readings across all 4 dimensions or filtered dimensions/categories (`dimension`, `category`) at the latest reading, an exact `month`, or a point-in-time `asOf`. Returns `overallRegime: null` and `stance: "no-data"` if the requested month has no data. Pro and Ultra receive full/filtered breakdowns; Basic receives HTTP 200 previewMode summary.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Optional dimension filter (1..4 or comma-separated e.g. 1,2). Mutually exclusive with category (HTTP 400).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category filter (consumer, manufacturing, commodities, labor-credit, or comma-separated). Mutually exclusive with dimension (HTTP 400).

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Exact calendar month snapshot (YYYY-MM). Mutually exclusive with asOf (HTTP 400).

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Point-in-time snapshot <= YYYY-MM. Mutually exclusive with month (HTTP 400).

200.description: Macro regime synthesis (or preview summary on Basic plan)

400.description: Invalid scope or time filter parameter

429.description: Too Many Requests — Plan rate limit exceeded

get.summary: Historical financial crisis cosine similarity diagnostics (Full: Ultra; Preview: Basic/Pro)
get.description: Computes cosine similarity and normalized similarity percentages (0-100%) comparing the 14-indicator Z-Score vector against 2001/2008/2020/2022 crisis signatures. Ultra supports exact `month` or `asOf` backtesting (returning `closestCrisis: null` and `comparisons: []` if fewer than 4 indicators exist for that month); Basic/Pro receive HTTP 200 previewMode label.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Evaluation snapshot window (use month or asOf for historical snapshots)

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Exact calendar month historical backtest (YYYY-MM, Ultra plan). Mutually exclusive with asOf (HTTP 400).

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Point-in-time historical backtest <= YYYY-MM (Ultra plan). Mutually exclusive with month (HTTP 400).

200.description: Cosine similarity comparison report against 4 historical crises (or preview label on Basic/Pro)

400.description: Unsupported window or invalid time filter parameter

429.description: Too Many Requests — Plan rate limit exceeded

get.summary: Bulk matrix fetch filtered by slugs, category, or time (Full: Ultra; Preview: Basic/Pro)
get.description: Retrieves sanitized historical snapshots across specified `slugs`, a `category`/`dimension` subset, or all 15 indices, optionally filtered by `month`, `asOf`, or `fromMonth`/`toMonth` (Ultra: up to 24 obs per index; Basic/Pro: HTTP 200 previewMode clamped to up to 2 indices and limit=1).

parameters.name: slugs
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of index slugs (cannot combine with dimension or category). When slugs, dimension, and category are all omitted, returns all 15 indices (or first 2 indices on Basic/Pro previewMode).

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Optional dimension filter (1..4 or comma-separated; cannot combine with slugs or category)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category filter (consumer, manufacturing, commodities, labor-credit, or comma-separated; cannot combine with slugs or dimension)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Observations per index (1-24, default 1)

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Exact month YYYY-MM match (returns [] for missing months)

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Point-in-time snapshot <= YYYY-MM

parameters.name: fromMonth
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound YYYY-MM

parameters.name: toMonth
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound YYYY-MM

200.description: Sanitized multi-index batch matrix (or preview slice on Basic/Pro)

400.description: Invalid slugs, category/dimension, limit, or time filter parameter

429.description: Too Many Requests — Plan rate limit exceeded
